main.name: Jeremiah Butler
main.description: 10+ years owning platform systems across high-scale commerce, enterprise cloud, and defense
main.bio: Software engineer with 10+ years experience across high-scale commerce, enterprise cloud, and defense. Takes on the problems nobody owns and nobody has scoped yet, and drives them to done.

work.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Owned the platform Subscriptions and Pre-orders APIs that all Shopify subscription apps build on
Built and maintained the open-source Subscriptions reference app: Shopify's first-party subscriptions product and the foundation enterprise merchants fork for bespoke subscription experiences

Built autonomous agent systems: integrated coding agents with Shopify's durable agent infrastructure so agent sessions ran unattended and survived restarts for day-to-day IC work; orchestrated multiple concurrent sessions through a voice-controlled conductor agent

Drove AI-assisted engineering: authored code-review agent skills (correctness, completeness, OO design). These caught an average of 8 issues per Pull Request which led to team-wide adoption; presented autonomous agent-loop techniques to hundreds of engineers on Shopify's internal broadcast platform
Refactored a core subscriptions data model fixing a one-to-one relationship that needed to become one-to-many. Handled migration of production data

Restructured team on-call and resiliency practices; built an agent that routed, categorized, and drafted root-cause analysis for incoming support requests, adopted by the team to absorb intake while burning down a backlog of ~20 resiliency issues to zero in 4 months; organized BFCM Game Day exercises (fault injection, monitoring hardening, mock support requests) ahead of peak load
Led 2 cross-team projects spanning B2B, checkout, legal, and UX
Mentored a junior engineer through to a senior promotion, plus 2 interns

work.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Published a generalized ETL collection framework, adopted into the SevOne product to replace one-off legacy Go and Python collectors; used it to build gNMI device collection
Developed a hybrid-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) monitoring solution for the IBM SevOne Network Performance Management platform
Ran twice-weekly code katas; team served as the model for the SevOne org's agile and DevOps migration

work.title: Advanced Software Engineer / Software Lead
bullets: Software technical lead on a microservice architecture for radio operators that won a $30M+ contract award; led multiple teams through the test events behind it
Architected large-scale cloud-based mission systems for DoD customers
Proposed and led internal research bringing machine learning to the tactical edge; adopted by at least 2 further projects
Created an innersource community with 100+ reusable projects; presented the concept to 130+ participants
